name: vagamatch
description: Agente pessoal para descoberta e preparação de candidaturas.

scripts.dev:api: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @vagamatch/database && npm run dev -w @vagamatch/api
scripts.build:api: npm run db:generate && npm run build:database && npm run build -w @vagamatch/api
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run db:generate && npm run build:database && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run db:generate && npm run build:database && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
